title: Secret Dialogue Between Master and Disciple
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji took the warm Jade Pendant, three muffled bell tolls rang out from the depths of Tianqing Sect—it was the signal for the opening of the Sect's Forbidden Grounds.

text.content: The night was as dark as ink. In the Bamboo Grove of Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, the bamboo leaves rustled in the cold wind. Chen Ji sat cross-legged on a Blue Stone, the Spiritual Light around him as dim as a dying candle in the wind. Though the killing intent from before had faded, it had left an indelible chill in his heart. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul phantom hung suspended in mid-air, his weathered face appearing particularly haggard under the moonlight. 'The presence you just sensed,' Mo Xiansheng's voice was low, 'was Ling Yuan. He has already noticed you.'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes, a self-mocking curve appearing at the corner of his mouth: 'Master means to say that this waste of a servant's identity won't stay hidden much longer?' He lowered his head to look at his withered hands, his tonecalm得近乎cold，'But it's merely one life. If he wants it, he can take it. It's just...' He paused, a flash of barely perceptible sharpness flickering in his eyes, 'I still have many things left undone.'

Mo Xiansheng gazed at the young man before him, his remnant soul trembling slightly: 'You are very much like him.' Chen Ji frowned slightly: 'Master speaks of...' 'Your father, Chen Xuan.' Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly dropped low, 'Thirty years ago, he was the most dazzling genius on this continent, and also the last complete wielder of the Tianji Record.' He paused for a moment, 'And I was his old friend.'

text.content: The bamboo leaves rustled, as if whispering long-buried secrets. Chen Ji's fingers tightened around the Tianji Record Fragment, his knuckles turning white. His father, that figure who had long become a blur in his memories, actually had such deep ties to all this. He took a deep breath, trying to suppress the turbulent emotions churning in his heart.

dialogue.content: 'Master,' Chen Ji's voice was somewhat hoarse, 'what kind of person was my father?' Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a long while, his ethereal form drifting slowly before Chen Ji, his ancient eyes filled with nostalgia: 'He was... a person who would defy heaven even knowing death was inevitable. The Tianji Record chose him, yet it also cursed him. And you... are the continuation of this curse.'

'The Tianji Record was originally a supreme treasure bestowed upon humanity by the Will of Heaven in ancient times.' Mo Xiansheng's voice gradually grew solemn, 'It can peer into heavenly secrets and foresee the future, yet it also carries the karmic consequences of heaven. Those who possess this object will surely incur heavenly jealousy—fate will continuously give them 'hope', then personally crush that hope.' He looked at Chen Ji, 'Your father could not escape this curse, and neither can you.'

text.content: Upon hearing this, Chen Ji反而笑了。That smile held no fear, only aindifferent that seemed to have seen through worldly affairs: 'So Master's meaning is that I am destined to be a tragedy?' He stood up, brushing the dust from his robes, 'So what. This Chen Ji never believes in fate.' He turned to look at Mo Xiansheng, the moonlight carving out his thin yet upright silhouette, 'Since heaven wants to play with me, I'll play this game to the end.'

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng看着眼前的少年眼中的光芒，his remnant soul suddenly剧烈颤抖起来。'像，太像了...' he murmured, eyes seeming to shimmer with tears, '当年你父亲说出同样的话时，也是这般神情。' His emotions suddenly收敛，his voice陡然严厉起来，'但你要记住——天道之眼已经注意到你了！'

text.content: 'The Eye of Heaven?' Chen Ji's brow furrowed tightly. He had seen only fragments of this name in ancient texts, yet never imagined it would have any connection to himself. Mo Xiansheng's expression was more serious than ever: 'That is an existence beyond mortal comprehension, and it treats all prophetic seers as chess pieces. The Tianji Record... is merely one of its pieces laid out in the mortal realm.'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji felt his spine grow cold, a chill rushing from his feet directly to his brain. He下意识握紧了天机录残页，knuckles white. 'So from the very beginning... I have been under its gaze?' His voice was very light, yet carried难以掩饰的颤抖。Mo Xiansheng nodded: 'Every time you use the Tianji Record's abilities, you are exposing your location. It is waiting—waiting for the moment you grow strong enough to be 'useful'.'

text.content: Chen Ji突然笑了，that smile带着几分crazed：'被动等死从来不是我的风格。Master, rather than letting it hunt me, let me investigate the hunter's true capabilities.' His voice was low and dangerous, 'Since heaven treats me as a chess piece, I'll overturn this chessboard and see exactly who the mastermind behind the scenes truly is.'

dialogue.content: 'Regardless of your choice, there is one thing I must tell you now.' Mo Xiansheng suddenly changed his tone, taking out a温润的玉佩from his怀。The Jade Pendant was entirely emerald green, its surface carved with intricate patterns, faintly emitting a soft glow. 'This is the last thing I can give you.' Mo Xiansheng placed the Jade Pendant into Chen Ji's hand, his expression solemn, 'It can save your life in a生死关头, but only once. Remember—only in true绝境may you use it.'

text.content: Chen Ji took the Jade Pendant; it was warm to the touch, as if still carrying a trace of Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul's warmth. He looked at this small Jade Pendant in his palm, suddenly feeling a pang in his nose. This master he had never met had exhausted his last drop of effort for thistrash. He carefully tucked the Jade Pendant into his怀, bowed deeply: 'Your disciple Chen Ji thanks Master for his profound kindness.'

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's ethereal form trembled slightly, agratified的笑意appearing on his苍老的面容: 'Rise, there is no need for such formality between us.' His voice gradually became ethereal, 'What I can teach you is already limited; the remaining road... you must walk it yourself.' The remnant soul began to slowly dissipate, Mo Xiansheng's form growing more faint, 'Remember, the secrets of the Tianji Record are many... when you are strong enough, I will tell you everything...'

text.content: 'Master!' Chen Ji reached out to grasp that gradually dissipating form, yet only touched emptiness. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul finally消散殆尽，leaving only a faint trace of墨香lingering in the air. Chen Ji stood stunned in place, clutching the warm Jade Pendant in his hand, eyes slightly reddened. The夜风blew past, bamboo leaves沙沙作响，as ifwhispered安慰着这个孤独的少年。

dialogue.content: After a long while, Chen Ji深吸一口气，repressing all emotions back into his heart. He looked up at the漆黑的夜空，eyes flashing withresolute的光芒: 'Father... Master...' he murmured softly, voice barely audible, 'I will not disappoint you.' He turned to gaze toward Tianqing Sect, eyes flickering with凌厉的寒芒，'Ling Yuan... and the so-called Eye of Heaven... you wait.'

text.content: Just as Chen Ji turned to leave, three muffled bell tolls suddenly echoed from the depths of Tianqing Sect. The bell sounds were deep and lingering, causing the entire Bamboo Grove to tremble. Chen Ji's footsteps halted, his expression changing slightly. He was all too familiar with this bell sound—the signal for the opening of the Sect's Forbidden Grounds! And the only person in all of Tianqing Sect who could open the Forbidden Grounds at night was one person. He gazed toward the depths of the Sect, eyes flickering with一丝grave。Ling Yuan... what are you planning?
